text:
sylvia: ⚠️ Security advisory — CVE pending. We found a deserialization bug in the kv-cache library (used by the runtime prefix cache) that can be triggered by crafted inputs and may expose cached payloads across requests. Initial detection: increased anomalous cache hits + unusual base64 payloads. Immediate actions below.

security-alert-bot: automated detection triggered: anomaly_score=0.98, affected_service=runtime-kvcache, sample_request_id=rt-9f3b2a

amanda: Confirming. I can throttle/disable the cache layer at the router. Plan: 1) disable kv-cache on Hosted + Dedicated pools in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 2) start token/service-account rotation 3) deploy runtime patch.

chris: Which pools exactly? Any impact to Private/VPC customers? Need to notify support/AE.

sylvia: Affected: hosted-api-prod, dedicated-pool-1 (us-west-2), dedicated-pool-3 (eu-west-1). Private deployments do NOT automatically pull our runtime; customers who upgraded to our managed runtime image may be impacted — CS will need to triage.

raj: I opened a patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2138 — it hardens deserialization, adds strict schema checks, and rejects malformed cache entries. Build: runtime/image:v1.3.9-hotfix1

raj: Short-term mitigation commands:
```
# disable prefix KV caching on router (central config)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://console.internal.redwood/api/admin/config \
  -d '{"runtime": {"kv_cache_enabled": false}}'
```

amanda: Running that now on hosted-api-prod and dedicated pools. Will also apply rate limits for cache-populating endpoints.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: runtime/image:v1.3.9-hotfix1 -> canary hosts 3/12 (hosted-api-prod). Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/2138

marta: I’ll draft a short customer-facing advisory for Dedicated customers and CS playbook for Private — will post in #customer-success within 30m.

chris: After disabling cache, what's the perf impact? SRE/infra needs runbook ready to scale replicas if latency spikes.

amanda: Expect ~8-12% p95 increase for generator endpoints. I'll pre-scale dedicated pools + enable burst nodes.

raj: We'll blocklist suspicious cache keys and run a sweep to zero-out potentially poisoned entries. Command: `kubectl exec -it cache-ctl -- ./cachectl purge --pattern "inbound:*"` (run from infra bastion).

sylvia: Authorization rotation: we will rotate a subset of short-lived tokens and service-account keys used for cache-write operations. Scope: cache-writer SA + router-admin token. Amanda, please rotate and publish new creds to vault; set old tokens to revoked.

amanda: On it. Revoking tokens now. ETA token revocation complete: 18m. Also creating emergency IAM key rotation runbook in Confluence.

security-alert-bot: note: revocation started by amanda at 1729004720, affected_token_prefixes=[cw-*, router-admin-*]

raj: Patch passing unit/integration tests. Rolling canary healthy after 6m. Requesting full rollout once cache disable is in place and tokens rotated.

deploy-bot: Canary health OK. 0 errors at 5m, latency within expected range. Proceed with staged rollout?

sylvia: Proceed with staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Amanda, confirm when revoke + cache disable are fully applied.

amanda: Revoke complete and central config set: kv_cache_enabled=false on targeted pools.

marta: Drafted customer advisory for Dedicated customers: short summary + mitigation + expected perf delta. Posting to #customer-success for review.

chris: Noted. Creating an SLO exception ticket and pre-scaling plan. If p95 stays within +20% we won't open a paging incident.

raj: Rolling out runtime/image:v1.3.9-hotfix1 to remaining hosts now. Patch includes telemetry to detect malformed cache entries; will auto-drop and log any attempts.

infra-bot: host host-12 patched, host-13 patched, host-14 patched. Remaining hosts: 9.

sylvia: Action items summary: 
- Disable kv-cache on affected pools (done)
- Revoke cache-write tokens + rotate SA keys (done)
- Patch runtime and rollout (in progress)
- Purge suspicious cache entries (raj/infra)
- Customer advisory and CS playbook (marta)
- SRE pre-scale & monitor (chris)

marta: I’ll coordinate timing for the Dedicated advisory email. Recommend 1hr notice after full rollout and verification.

chris: I'll monitor error budgets and be on-call for the next 3 hours.

raj: Completed cache sweep on hosted-api-prod; purge count=1,214 entries. No further suspicious patterns detected so far.

security-alert-bot: incident note appended: incident/2024-06-hr-kv-01; severity=high; owner=@sylvia; followup_ticket=SEC-459

sylvia: Good work team. Follow-up: postmortem template will be assigned to SEC-459 with a 72h deadline. Keep this channel updated with any new indicators. I'll publish an internal advisory to execs in ~30m. :thumbsup:

amanda: Confirming all targeted pools at 100% patched and cache disabled. Re-enable will only happen after a full security signoff.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: runtime/image:v1.3.9-hotfix1 -> all targeted hosts.

sylvia: Closing loop — incident doc: https://confluence.internal.redwood/x/kv-incident-2024 (draft). I’ll convert to postmortem after initial analysis. Thanks everyone.

chris: Will update on-call handoff notes.

marta: Customer comms sent to affected Dedicated accounts per the reviewed template.

sylvia: If anyone spots odd cache-related alerts, ping me immediately.
